base_service_time_distributions.description: Base service-time distributions for activity-resource pairs. Sparse pairs fall back to activity-level distributions. Dynamic resource DBN adjusts sampled base service times at runtime.

resource_state_dbn.description: A discrete two-slice dynamic Bayesian network for resource-state evolution. The DBN learns conditional transition probabilities from resource-level state-transition samples.

resource_selection.note: This factor is learned from the states of actually selected resources. For a stricter resource-choice model, construct chosen/not-chosen samples from enabled resource sets.

queue_scheduling_model.description: A global white-box resource-allocation tree over task-resource pairs. Queue-state features make allocation queue-aware; actual task dispatch order is modeled separately by the Conditional Prioritization Tree.

metadata.modeling_note: This tree learns queue-aware resource allocation from task-resource candidate pairs. It does not determine which waiting task is dispatched next; that responsibility belongs to conditional_prioritization.
metadata.queue_explanation_target: resource-competition waiting should be represented by candidate_resource_wait_min and runtime capacity enforcement; external delay should only model residual waiting.
metadata.resource_calibration_target: validation CWD with complete runtime metrics as final tie-breaker

conditional_prioritization.description: Pairwise white-box queue-dispatch model. At a resource dispatch point, it ranks simultaneously waiting eligible tasks and selects the next task.

metadata.training_target: pairwise actual dispatch order conditioned on assigned resource and ready-queue state

external_delay_model.description: Simod-lite activity-specific timer model for non-resource residual waiting. Activities with sufficient positive residual support receive an editable activity-level timer distribution; sparse activities shrink to a pooled capped global empirical distribution.

metadata.queue_residual_policy: Resource-capacity waiting is credited to Queue; off-duty waiting on the remaining intervals is credited to Calendar; External is the residual.
metadata.modeling_note: Simod-lite mode: disabled activities sample zero external delay; activities with enough positive residual observations use capped activity-level empirical timers; sparse activities use the pooled capped global distribution instead of replaying rare outliers.

external_delay.note: Queue scheduling explains resource-competition waiting; external-delay trees add non-resource residual start delays.
